mapper.sql: t.uuid, t.type, t.point_count, t.plate_key, t.enter_time, t.exit_time, t.trail_points, t.create_time, t.enter_locationcode, t.exit_locationcode, t.track_josn, t.enaxlecount, t.entolllaneid, t.entollstationid, t.entollstationname, t.envehicleclass, t.envehicleid, t.envehicletype, t.enweight, t.extolllaneid, t.extollstationid, t.extollstationname, t.exvehicleclass, t.exvehicleid, t.exvehicletype, t.exweight, t.start_lon, t.strat_lat, t.end_lon, t.end_lat
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, passCount FROM (SELECT t.uuid, gc.passCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.plate_key, t.entollstationid, t.extollstationid ORDER BY t.enter_time DESC ) as rn FROM zdata_trail_tracks t INNER JOIN (SELECT plate_key, entollstationid, extollstationid, COUNT(*) as passCount FROM zdata_trail_tracks t WHERE 1=1 and t.plate_key = #{carNo} and t.enter_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime1},'%Y-%m-%d') and t.enter_time < date_add(STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime2},'%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day) GROUP BY plate_key, entollstationid, extollstationid ORDER BY passCount DESC LIMIT 3) gc ON t.plate_key = gc.plate_key AND t.entollstationid = gc.entollstationid AND t.extollstationid = gc.extollstationid) a WHERE rn = 1 order by passCount desc
